dashboard.cardCommunicationDesc: Useful phrases to show on screen
dashboard.tip0: Arrive at the airport at least 3 hours early if you need special assistance. Most airports offer mobility services with advance reservation.
dashboard.tip1: Research your hotel's accessibility features before booking. Request written confirmation of the accommodations you need.
dashboard.tip2: Download offline maps of your destination. In an emergency, you'll be able to navigate without internet access.
dashboard.tip3: Always carry your medications in your carry-on luggage, never in checked bags. Pack double the amount you need.
dashboard.tip4: Research whether your destination has adapted transportation apps. Many cities offer specific options for people with disabilities.
dashboard.tip5: Communicate your needs to the flight attendant when boarding. They can help with the boarding and disembarking process.
dashboard.tip6: Look for traveler groups with the same disability on social media. Their firsthand experiences are invaluable for planning your trip.

landing.storyTitle: Born from love, so no one stays home
landing.storyP1: I grew up traveling with my dad, who has reduced mobility. We both loved to travel, but every trip began with the same fear: not knowing what we’d find. Would there be a ramp, or would stairs stop us? Would the bathroom really be accessible? That fear — the fear of us both — often made us hesitate to even go.
landing.storyP2: I didn’t want fear to keep stealing our trips. That’s why AllGo Travel App was born: so anyone, with any need, can say “yes, let’s go” again. Because traveling isn’t a privilege. It’s a right.

landing.alliTitle: Short answers, with their source and date
landing.alliLead: This is what the verified information Alli, your AI assistant, works with looks like.
landing.alliQ1: How do I request help at airport security in the U.S.?
landing.alliA1: Call TSA Cares at least 72 hours ahead and ask for a Passenger Support Specialist. It is a TSA recommendation, not a law.
landing.alliQ2: I requested wheelchair assistance. Can they leave me waiting?
landing.alliA2: The airline cannot leave you unattended for more than 30 minutes in a wheelchair or other device you cannot move on your own.
landing.alliQ3: Flying in Europe: how far ahead should I request assistance?
landing.alliA3: At least 48 hours ahead. If you notify later, they must make reasonable efforts, but it is no longer guaranteed.

landing.h3FaqQ2: What's the difference between a service dog and an emotional support animal?
landing.h3FaqA2: For flying in the U.S., a service dog is a dog individually trained to perform specific tasks for its person. Since January 11, 2021, under the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) rule, airlines are no longer required to accept emotional support animals as service animals and may treat them as pets. Only trained service dogs keep the protection to travel in the cabin at no charge. The airline may ask you for the DOT Service Animal Air Transportation Form. Source: U.S. Department of Transportation · transportation.gov.
landing.h3FaqQ3: Which countries does it apply to?
landing.h3FaqA3: Service Dog Guide: the DOT rules apply to flights to, from and within the U.S. The guide also covers the requirements to enter Latin America and the European Union with your dog (and what changes in destinations like the United Kingdom), U.S., Latin American and Spanish airlines, and cruises. Turismo Sin Fronteras Guide: a guide to plan any trip, with accessible destinations by traveler profile and key airport and cruise deadlines. Always verify with your airline and destination country before you travel.
landing.h3FaqA4: The purchase is made on Hotmart. As soon as your payment is confirmed, you get instant access by email to download your guide and read it on your phone, tablet or computer.
landing.h3FaqQ5: What if it's not for me?
landing.h3FaqA5: You have Hotmart's 7-day guarantee: if the guide isn't what you expected, request a refund within those 7 days.
landing.h3FaqA6: No. AllGo Travel App doesn't sell flights, hotels or bookings. We give you information checked against official sources and tools to prepare your trip. This is informational guidance, not legal advice.
